The function $y=f(x)$ is shown above. Which of the following gives the plot of $y=-f(x)?$
q-12736.worked_solution:
To obtain the graph of $y=-f(x)$ from $y=f(x)$, we need to reflect the graph over the $x$-axis. The resulting graph is shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14227246/assets/274973fd4068d7d509f735ad01775b25ae55102ae2c5d9aa6469b0043c598fe9.png)
